name: Franz Josef Glacier
bio: A glacier tumbling from the Southern Alps into rainforest — walk the valley to its viewpoint or heli-hike onto the ice.

name: Fox Glacier
bio: Franz Josef's twin, a 12 km river of ice whose valley walk shows how fast the glacier has retreated.

name: Lake Matheson
bio: A dark, still lake that mirrors Aoraki / Mount Cook and Mount Tasman on calm mornings.

name: Glacier Hot Pools
bio: Hot pools set in the rainforest at the edge of the village, fed by glacier water.

name: West Coast Wildlife Centre
bio: A hatchery raising rowi and Haast tokoeka — the world's rarest kiwi — with a nocturnal viewing house.

name: Okarito
bio: A tiny coastal hamlet on New Zealand's largest unmodified wetland, for kayaking, birdwatching and kiwi tours.

name: Hokitika Gorge
bio: Milky turquoise water between white granite walls, crossed by a swing bridge in podocarp forest.

name: Hokitika Beach
bio: A wild driftwood-strewn beach with a giant driftwood HOKITIKA sign and blazing Tasman Sea sunsets.

name: West Coast Treetop Walk
bio: A steel walkway 20 m up in the canopy of an ancient rimu and kāmahi forest, with a tower above.

name: Lake Kaniere
bio: A clear, forest-ringed lake with swimming, kayaking and the Dorothy Falls waterfall on its shore.

name: Hokitika Glow-worm Dell
bio: A short path at the edge of town into a mossy dell that glitters with glowworms after dark.

name: Pancake Rocks
bio: Layered limestone stacks like piles of pancakes, with blowholes that roar and spout at high tide.

name: Truman Track
bio: A short walk through coastal forest to a wild beach of caves, rock pools and a waterfall dropping onto the sand.

name: Pororari River Track
bio: A riverside path beneath limestone cliffs and nīkau palms, through a gorge of deep green pools.

name: Paparoa Track
bio: A Great Walk and Great Ride over the Paparoa Range, ending down the Pororari gorge to the coast.

name: Punakaiki Cavern
bio: A roadside limestone cave you can explore by torchlight, with stalactites and glowworms.

name: Shantytown Heritage Park
bio: A recreated 1860s gold-rush town with a steam train, sawmill and the chance to pan for real gold.

name: Monteith's Brewery
bio: The original home of one of New Zealand's best-known beers, with brewery tours and a tasting bar.

name: Point Elizabeth Walkway
bio: A coastal track through nīkau palms and rātā forest to a lookout over the Tasman Sea.

name: Cape Foulwind
bio: A windswept clifftop walkway from the lighthouse to the Tauranga Bay fur seal colony.

name: Denniston Plateau
bio: The remains of a hilltop coal town and its 'Eighth Wonder' incline, which lowered coal wagons down a sheer slope.

name: Coaltown Museum
bio: A modern museum telling the story of the West Coast's coal and gold mining, including a replica Denniston wagon.
